title: A recursive sum with PUSH and POP
task: Write a recursive subroutine sum that returns 1 + 2 + … + R0 in R0: 0 for R0 = 0, otherwise R0 + sum(R0 − 1). It saves R4 and LR with PUSH {R4, LR} and returns with POP {R4, PC}. The main program loads the word at n (0 to 100), calls sum with BL, stores the result at total and ends with B . . Every PUSH must be undone: the tests also check that SP is back at 0x00100000. It uses instruction-level forms, so it runs in the Instructions view only. Keep the labels n and total and their lines.
